# Futuruna

> Futuruna works by allowing high expressional strength through a technique called "partitioned syntax", that allows both law encoding and normal programming paradigms to work side by side.

A front rune gives each kind of statement its own space, so its capabilities do not have to compete with those in the language's other spaces. This gives the author more options for writing a good program while giving the reader less uncertainty about what they are reading.

Futuruna is designed for humans and AIs alike. Start with the AI setup or the first tutorial. If you want to understand why Futuruna exists, read the manifest.

Contact: research@futuruna.com

## Start Here

- [AI setup](https://futuruna.com/ai-setup.md): Give this guide to your AI and let it set up Futuruna with you.
- [Guided tutorial](https://futuruna.com/docs/tutorial): Build a small synthetic tax model, prove the result, and let Futuruna expose a real contradiction.
- [Guided tutorial source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/tutorial/README.md): Read the same guide as source Markdown for agents and tools.
- [Why Futuruna](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/why.md): Read why law encoding and ordinary programming belong in the same language.

## Learn Futuruna

- [Reference index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/README.md): Read the maintained reference when you need the exact language.
- [Language basics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/basics.md): Learn Futuruna's ordinary programming foundations.
- [The seven runes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/runes.md): See how front runes give each kind of statement its own space.
- [Modeling style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/style.md): Learn to keep source-backed rules, facts, assumptions, interpretations, and unknowns separate.
- [Typed calculations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/calculations.md): Turn a typed rule model into structured inputs, interview questions, workbooks, and deterministic results.

## For AIs

- [Futuruna skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/.agents/skills/futuruna/SKILL.md): Use the maintained workflow for learning, writing, checking, and explaining Futuruna.
- [Learning path](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/.agents/skills/futuruna/references/learning-path.md): Learn the seven front runes through one small working program at a time.

## Working Examples

- [Weather demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/examples/weather_demo.runa): See all seven front runes working together in one small program.
- [Logic rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/examples/cocktails.runa): See facts, rules, queries, and ordinary collection processing work side by side.
- [Typed calculation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/tests/fixtures/calculation/tax.calculate.runa): See a small rule model become a typed, interview-ready calculation.

## Law, Rules, and Research

- [The Philosophy of Futuruna](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/research.md): Read the deeper argument for partitioned syntax.
- [Danish personal income tax](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/examples/danish-income-tax/website-overblik.md): Explore the Danish Income Tax Law encoded in Futuruna and audit your own Annual Tax Report.
- [Danish Constitution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/examples/danish-constitution/webside.md): Explore the Danish Constitution encoded in Futuruna.
- [Danish Constitution audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/examples/danish-constitution/grundlov.audit.runa): Read the executable audit of the encoded Danish Constitution.
- [US Constitution foundation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/examples/us-constitution/constitution.runa): Read the shared vocabulary, dates, preamble, and first rules of the encoded Constitution.
- [US Constitution verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/examples/us-constitution/verification.runa): See executable checks that draw the encoded articles together.
- [Invisible Ownership](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/research-ownership.md): See how Futuruna infers Rust-level ownership without ownership annotations.
